name: onbudget
description: Give a Claude Code task a spending limit, in dollars or as a share of your 5-hour or weekly usage; Claude sees what's left as it works, and onbudget stops it before the limit runs out.

effort.title: Effort cap while a budget is set
effort.description: Requests sent under a budget have their reasoning effort lowered to this level (never raised). keep leaves your effort setting alone.

usdPerPoint5h.title: Dollars per point, 5-hour window
usdPerPoint5h.description: Optional. List-price dollars of usage that move your 5-hour usage window by one percentage point. 0 means learn it from this account's own readings.

usdPerPointWeek.title: Dollars per point, weekly window
usdPerPointWeek.description: Optional. List-price dollars of usage that move your weekly usage window by one percentage point. 0 means weekly budgets count the window's own points; the rate learned from this account's readings is then used only for the weekly limit under other budgets.
